name: senior-pm
description: Repository-grounded Senior PM plugin for OpenCode

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Publication is disabled for this source preview'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && tsup --config tsup.config.ts && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.test:integration:run: npm run test:integration:core:run && npm run test:integration:runtime:run
scripts.test:integration:core: npm run build && npm run test:integration:core:run
scripts.test:integration:runtime: npm run build && npm run test:integration:runtime:run
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration:run
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
